premises.text: Marketplace where designers sell professional 3D printable files for passive income
premises.evidence_span: designers can sell professional level 3D printable files rather than just giving them away on sites like Thingiverse

premises.text: Consumers buy, customize, download, and print at home or via networked print shops worldwide
premises.evidence_span: Once purchased, you can view the file in your library. You can also download the design and print real shoes from your own 3D printer

premises.text: Revenue from designs and print sales; competing print shops commoditize price downward
premises.evidence_span: we generate revenue from the design and profit from the sale of print

premises.text: Direct designer collaboration can fast-track new products when the catalog lacks an item
premises.evidence_span: Don't see what you want? You can work directly with our designers to fast-track the innovation to new products

value.text: Power to choose when, where, and how purchased products are manufactured
value.evidence_span: give you the power to choose when, where, and how the products you buy are manufactured

causal_links.evidence_span: manufacture right from the comfort of your home

notes: Print-shop network folded into consumer fulfillment P2. Visionary market-ownership lines not premised. Singleton pricing domain retained.
